title: A focused cargo test run that fails with recognised counts (exit 101, 0 passed / N failed) is recorded as result indeterminate / producer unknown instead of failed
outcome: A focused cargo test run that fails with recognised counts (exit 101, 0 passed / N failed) is recorded as result indeterminate / producer unknown instead of failed
acceptance: The failing path is identified with file:line: why a focused launcher run `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- cargo test --bin termal <filter>` that exits non-zero with recognisable libtest counts (0 passed, N failed) is typed as result indeterminate / producer_outcome unknown rather than failed.

A regression: such a run produces a host verification record with result failed and the counts, so fail-first (RED) evidence is host-typed; a run with no recognisable counts or a cut output still records as it does today.
docs/test.md states how a failing focused run is recorded.
